白い熊 店 4.8.4+020
• Hold an app at its installed version: a “Hold at current version” toggle in the app page’s ⋯ menu
• A held app’s update is still listed on the Updates tab under Ignored, for information — not counted in the total or the badge, and left out of Update all
• The background update check now honours ignore rules: ignored and held apps are no longer notified or auto-installed
